# The first mutation run fails and prints nothing. The fix lane gets one finding with the exit code, and the head gets no review before the fix.
env REPO=o/r BASE=integration OWNER_LOGIN=owner OWNER_EMAIL=owner@example.com SOURCE_CHECKOUT=/own/checkout
exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'

grep -count=2 '^build mutation sh mutation.sh origin/integration$' mutation.log
grep -count=1 '^fix 1 ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^review ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^The mutation command exited with code 1 and printed no finding.' findings.log

-- mutations --
silent
clean
-- verdicts --
approve
